{{Quote|This one is mine. I no longer use yours.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi (novel)">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' (novel)]]</ref>}}
'''Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber''', also known as '''Luke Skywalker's lightsaber''', was the first [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] constructed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the second one he owned.

==Specifications==
===Construction===
[[File:KnightOfPassage-SWGs7.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker assembling his lightsaber]]
This weapon's design was based on schematics Luke found in a [[Obi-Wan's Journal|book]] that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] left for Luke in [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|his hut]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While the final product remained largely faithful to these designs, Luke simplified the weapon considerably, as this was his first attempt at constructing a lightsaber. For instance; he decided to use only one crystal for his lightsaber, as opposed to the ideal three to allow for a fully adjustable blade. Luke was able to gather most of the parts he required to build his weapon from various vendors in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], including a high-energy reflector cup, power cells and a focusing lens. However, Luke was unable to obtain the one vital component that would bring the whole project together: the lightsaber crystal itself.<ref name="SOTE" />

In the years following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] establishment in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], great efforts were taken to expunge the last remaining resources of the fallen [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from the galaxy. One of these measures was the banning of all crystals capable of being used in the construction of lightsabers, and shutting down the sites that possessed these crystals. Possessing lightsabers was also outlawed with the exception of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Emperor's [[Emperor's Shadow Guard|Shadow Guards]], and the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]. Others who possessed lightsabers collected them as a trophies from fallen Jedi. Due to this, Luke was forced to fabricate his own green [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic lightsaber crystal]], utilizing a small blast furnace and the book of instructions found within the home of his fallen Master on Tatooine.<ref name="SOTE" />

[[File:Lukeonskiff.png|thumb|right|150px|Luke Skywalker wielding his lightsaber aboard the ''Khetanna'' during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].]]
For many days, Luke labored over the components, checking and then re-checking the instructions many times, taking no shortcuts. Over a month after he first began, the weapon still was not complete. Luke had to interrupt his work on the project while he and his friends mounted an ultimately unsuccessful rescue for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] custody on the planet [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. Returning to Tatooine, Luke resumed his work on the weapon, cutting and shaving the unrefined crystal he had created into a proper multi-faceted lightsaber jewel.<ref name="SOTE" /> He continued to consult the book for the final step, perfectly aligning the components so that the weapon would function. After numerous failed attempts, Luke, remembering [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] words "Do, or do not," closed the book, connected to his weapon in the Force, and relied on his intuition to complete the construction.<ref name="Tatooine Haunts">{{RJRadio|Tatooine Haunts}}</ref>

===Functionality===
When Luke Skywalker first ignited the weapon, it functioned perfectly. The green blade emitted no heat, signifying that the internal superconductors were working properly, and it sheared through a wrist-thick rock spire with no difficulty. Luke also noted that the weapon possessed good balance, possibly superior to that of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="SOTE" /> The lightsaber made a distinctive ''snap-hiss'' sound when activated, which was different to that emitted by his previous weapon.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==History==
{{Quote|I see you have constructed a new lightsaber. Your skills are complete. Indeed you are powerful, as the Emperor has foreseen.|Darth Vader examining Luke Skywalker's lightsaber|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the construction of his Jedi weapon gave the confidence Luke Skywalker needed to progress in his studies as he advanced toward becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. 

[[File:Kotlis_safehouse_attack.jpg|thumb|200px|Luke fends off bounty hunters on Kothlis with his new lightsaber.]]
It was not long after building it that Luke would first use the lightsaber in combat, when he was attacked at Ben Kenobi's hut by an armed [[swoop gang]], hunting a bounty posted by the crimelord [[Xizor/Legends|Prince Xizor]]. He would later use the weapon in the [[Battle of Kothlis]], but it was confiscated following his capture by other bounty hunters. After escaping and retrieving the saber, Luke traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and wielded it during a mission to rescue [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], which culminated in the [[Destruction of Xizor's Palace]].<ref name="SOTE" />

[[File:Lukevaderrotj7.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker wielding his lightsaber during his rematch with Darth Vader.]]
A year later, the young Jedi used the weapon during the desperate rescue of his friends from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] hands on Tatooine. On the moon's surface of Endor, he used it to deflect the blaster fire from [[Misik]]'s [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder]] and sliced the speeder's steering vane, before Misik crashed into the tree. Aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], Luke used his lightsaber during his [[Battle of Endor/Legends#Demise of the Sith|final confrontation]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was inspecting the lightsaber, he claimed that the design was much like his father's. At the climax of his duel with Vader, as he stood with the weapon leveled at his fallen father's throat, Luke refused to give in to Palpatine's goading to slay his father and submit to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], shutting his lightsaber off and hurling the weapon aside. Luke would later retrieve his lightsaber after being rescued by his redeemed father from the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor's]] barrage of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], wearing the weapon at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] victory celebrations on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:L_versus_s.jpg|thumb|right|Luke's lightsaber was temporarily red when he joined the reborn Palpatine.]]
Luke would go on to wield his lightsaber in the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], seeing repeated use. The weapon was at his side as Luke oversaw the rebirth of the Jedi Order and the repeated conflicts that followed, including the struggles against the Imperial Remnant, the Yuuzhan Vong and the Killiks. During his brief apprenticeship under the reborn Palpatine, Luke's lightsaber featured a red blade, which he ultimately wielded in rebellion against his would-be master, overcoming him.<ref name="Dark Empire 6" />

A legend later claimed that the lightsaber could be found inside the remains of [[Outpost 17]], an outpost in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that had been destroyed during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> This would turn out to be a myth, as Skywalker would continue to wield this lightsaber years after the Yuuzhan Vong war, including during the [[Swarm War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Later, he would take the weapon with him into his imposed exile in [[43 ABY]]. The weapon was still with him as of [[44 ABY]], when he used it to kill [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

[[File:Luke_Onslaught.jpg|thumb|left|Luke with his primary and backup weapon.]]
Luke would go on to craft more lightsabers in his lifetime, either to complement or replace his green one. These included a [[Luke Skywalker's shoto|short-bladed red version]], known as a [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto]], which he wielded alongside the green saber to counteract the [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] [[Lumiya]].<ref name="Star Wars 97">[[Star Wars (1977) 96|''Star Wars'' (1977) 96]]</ref><ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> At some point prior to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Luke constructed a backup lightsaber that was nearly identical to his green one, stored it inside [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and utilized it after his primary lightsaber was confiscated by [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]], though he would ultimately retrieve the original weapon.<ref name="DNIII:TSW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
{{Expandsect}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lukesabercutscene.png|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker activating his lightsaber for the first time.]]
For decades, fans were intrigued by a rumored "lightsaber construction scene" in which Luke constructs this lightsaber in a cave on Tatooine. Though storyboards for the scene existed, [[Mark Hamill]] denied that he ever filmed the scene. However, at [[Celebration V]] in 2010, Hamill and [[George Lucas]] debuted the deleted clip, which included a brief sequence where Luke assembles the lightsaber, then activates it for the first time. The clip was later included in the saga Blu-ray boxset.

The original prop lightsaber hilt Mark Hamill used in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] was flown on Space Shuttle Discovery on October 20th, 2007, which coincidentally launched at [[1138 (easter egg)|11:38]] a.m EDT from Pad 39A.
